discovery_notes: 28 standard searches, all search_snippet; blocked domains excluded. Mainly Disney Pins Blog, WDW News Today, Disney Food Blog, WDWInfo. Conflicts recorded: GE mini-jumbo naming (WDWNT 'Jumbo' LE2000), FotA Pluto AP price 17.99 vs 14.99, F&G Mickey logo 15.99 vs 14.99, MNSSHP logo/AP prices, Journey Into Imagination MoH 2000 vs 3000, holiday bells date Nov 7 vs Nov 11, F&W Figment 19.99 vs 17.99. TIE Echelon attribution to DPB Sept wk1 post is from a summarized snippet. Gaps: monthly MoH pins other than #3/#10, GE countdown #1-2, gingerbread locations, bell characters, FairyTails themed sets, Runaway Railway (2020). Reseller pages (yourwdwstore, parkscollectibles, magicalears) ignored. No prompt-injection content seen.
